name: An Amazing Day
source:
Ren, Aya, and Sophie live on the alternate planet Eterna. One’s a lovable idiot, one’s sassy, and one’s constantly exasperated. Together, they argue, laugh, twerk, and turn ordinary days into absolute mayhem.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=35414]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
